observations: All twelve PNGs were independently opened: full stage and face crop for baseline and candidate in adult wide, child narrow normal, and infant narrow high contrast views.
The adult wide composition matches: hand, fingertips, face and neck silhouette, ear and nose retain their existing placement and size.

The baseline child view already contains the face and supporting hand. The candidate noticeably reduces their size and introduces the far arm and torso; the extra context makes cheek contact harder to inspect in a Supporting hand close-up.

The infant candidate restores the clipped head and nose outline, but the head and supporting hand become roughly half their previous visible size. The newly visible upper body and far hand occupy much of the narrow stage.
Reject this candidate for visual quality. Keep the original narrow fit when the whole head and supporting hand already fit, and add only the minimum framing needed for clipped views.
limitations: Independent visual review of the twelve pinned raw-module images. Geometric and browser checks passed, but their all-in-frame condition does not establish a useful close-up. Full application loader/build/deployment were not tested.
